tables.name: Dragonborn Naming Method
tables.description: Formal Clan + Given name. Ancestral 38%, Great Clans 30%, Honour 20%, Wyrmblood 10%, Mortal-influenced 2%. 50 ordinary weighted bank routes, each selecting two 1d100 tables.
